title: Mathematics and Logic
lineage: 1955 essay reproduced in the MacTutor History of Mathematics archive; inspected the section on Boole. The author’s broader historical claims may be dated; local file is notes.

passages.note: Section on Boole: a sketch of the algebra of logic appeared in 1847, followed by a fuller account in Laws of Thought in 1854. Boole represented classes using algebraic symbols.
